data.name: Manisha
data.gender_notes: Manisha is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit manas, 'mind' — manīṣā, 'intelligence, wisdom'. Its root is Sanskrit manas (मनस्). A classical Sanskrit term for wisdom. Manisha is a Sanskrit name meaning “Intelligence; wisdom; desire”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Manisha expresses “Intelligence; wisdom; desire”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit manas, 'mind' — manīṣā, 'intelligence, wisdom'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manisha total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

data.cultural_impact: Manisha is used in Sanskrit naming tradition with the meaning “Intelligence; wisdom; desire”.

vedic_reference.note: Manisha is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Manas' (mind) and 'Isha' (lady, ruler). It symbolizes the power of the mind and one's innermost desires.

historical_references.reference: A classical Sanskrit term for wisdom.

modern_usage.modern_context: No verified modern-usage statistics are published for Manisha.

name_in_real_life.note: No verified real-life bearer is published for this name.
